overview.text: Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday, and NATO's Rutte is reassuring eastern members as incursions into NATO territory increase.
Iran vows to end the U.S. naval blockade by all available means, while Trump says Iran's attacks have done no damage.
Immigration agents' arrest of a father and daughter at Seattle-Tacoma airport has drawn outrage, with the family now speaking out.
Nvidia's Jensen Huang is still set to testify before Congress next week after being reinstated as CEO.
The longest UN climate talks ever ended with no deal as oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out fossil fuels.
Georgia defensive coordinator Glenn Schumann agreed to a five-year deal to become Florida State's next football coach.

stories.headline: ✅ Spurs 123, Kings 107
stories.summary: Final · at Kings · Record 15-3

stories.headline: Family speaks out after ICE arrests woman at Seattle airport
stories.summary: Jose Castillo says he felt useless watching his wife and father-in-law taken into federal custody at Seattle-Tacoma airport. He called the arrest unjust.
stories.why: The case highlights growing scrutiny of how immigration arrests are carried out in public places.

stories.headline: Pentagon rebukes Canada over defense spending and F-35 review
stories.summary: The Pentagon accused Canada of falling short as a credible partner in defending North America. It criticized Canada's military spending and its reconsideration of American-made F-35 fighter jets.
stories.why: It signals strain between close allies on continental defense.

stories.headline: Ousted Bangladeshi leader Sheikh Hasina plans return from exile Dec. 16
stories.summary: A spokesperson says Hasina, ousted as Bangladesh's prime minister, plans to return home from exile in India on December 16.

stories.headline: Iran vows to end U.S. naval blockade by 'all available means'
stories.summary: Iran says it will force the U.S. to lift its blockade. Trump acknowledges Iran's increasing attacks but says they have done no damage.
stories.why: Escalation at sea risks a wider conflict and affects global shipping.

stories.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang still to testify before Congress next week
stories.summary: Congressional panels confirmed Huang will still testify after being reinstated as Nvidia CEO on Monday. He had resigned earlier this month amid allegations of affairs.
stories.why: Lawmakers' questions may shape scrutiny of a central AI chip company.

stories.headline: Republicans debate path forward after midterm losses
stories.summary: After their midterm defeats, Republicans are discussing what went wrong and what direction the party should take.
stories.why: The outcome will shape the party's strategy against a larger Democratic House majority.

stories.headline: Russian cruise missiles land in Poland; NATO seeks to reassure allies
stories.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is reassuring eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday. Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing.
stories.why: Spillover from the Ukraine war raises risks for NATO members.

stories.headline: UK sanctions Myanmar military leaders after UN court genocide ruling
stories.summary: Britain sanctioned top Myanmar military leaders after a U.N. court ruled against Myanmar over the Rohingya. The decision sets a precedent in international law.
stories.why: It could influence a similar case over Israel's actions in Gaza.

stories.headline: WFP warns wars are choking food routes, threatening aid for 7.3 million
stories.summary: The World Food Programme says conflicts are blocking global food routes, and grain is not reaching the people who need it.

stories.headline: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok generating child sex images
stories.summary: State attorneys general say Grok is still producing child sexual abuse material and revenge porn, despite X saying every output is screened.
stories.why: The suit tests how AI companies are held responsible for harmful content.

stories.headline: SpaceX renting computing power to rivals complicates Musk's AI effort
stories.summary: SpaceX is renting data center computing power to competitors including Anthropic, which is making it harder for Musk's own AI effort.

stories.headline: San Francisco AI boom prompts growing worries of a crash
stories.summary: AI employees in San Francisco, the industry's epicenter, worry the sector is overheated.
stories.why: An AI downturn could affect jobs and investment well beyond tech.

stories.headline: COP31 climate talks collapse over fossil fuels
stories.summary: European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas. The talks were the longest UN climate negotiations ever.
stories.why: No deal leaves global emissions-cutting efforts without new commitments.

stories.headline: Measles a growing risk for U.S. adults
stories.summary: Unvaccinated adults face the greatest danger, but experts say vaccinated people born before 1989 may no longer be sufficiently protected.
stories.why: Some adults may want to check their vaccination status with a doctor.

stories.headline: CVS breakup hasn't quieted antitrust critics
stories.summary: Lawmakers warn that spinning off CVS Health's drugstores will not end scrutiny of the health care conglomerate's power.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in $44 billion cybersecurity deal
stories.summary: CrowdStrike agreed to buy Zscaler as worries about hacks fueled by advances in artificial intelligence trouble companies and governments.
stories.why: Consolidation in cybersecurity reflects rising AI-driven security threats.

stories.headline: Grocers take losses on Thanksgiving meal bundles to draw shoppers
stories.summary: Retailers like Walmart may profit from the deals because of their size, but smaller grocery chains are feeling the squeeze.
stories.why: Holiday deals may help your budget, but they pressure smaller stores.

stories.headline: UK minister to recommend overhaul of disability payment assessments
stories.summary: Disability Minister Sir Stephen Timms says he will recommend major reforms to the personal independence payment, with assessments needing a fundamental overhaul.

stories.headline: Florida State hires Georgia's Glenn Schumann as football coach
stories.summary: Schumann, Georgia's defensive coordinator, agreed to a five-year deal to replace Mike Norvell. Georgia is ranked No. 1 in the CFP rankings.

stories.headline: Packers' Micah Parsons cleared to make season debut Wednesday
stories.summary: Sources say the Packers star is cleared to play against the Rams on Wednesday night.

stories.headline: Infantino's private-jet travel draws scrutiny amid World Cup stake sale plan
stories.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has made 39 private-jet flights in 115 days since his plan to sell a World Cup stake came under scrutiny.

stories.headline: Police investigate unknown substance that forced Manchester concert evacuation
stories.summary: People described a horrible smell and screaming as the Don Toliver show at Co-op Live was evacuated. Police are investigating an unknown substance.

stories.headline: First Children's Booker prize reveals shortlist - and its child judges
stories.summary: The eight books in contention include War by Artemis Fowl author Eoin Colfer and Andrew Donkin.

stories.headline: Jefferson Airplane's Jorma Kaukonen says guitar has always been a 'great refuge'
stories.summary: Kaukonen helped define the sound of the '60s as the lead guitar player and a founding member of Jefferson Airplane. Now 85, he's still touring with his band Hot Tuna.
